description: Source code for Zephyr OS settings shell commands, providing CLI for listing, reading, writing, and deleting settings via shell interface.

methods.name: settings_list_callback
methods.description: Callback for listing settings, prints keys with optional subtree prefix.

methods.name: cmd_list
methods.description: Handles 'settings list' command, loads and lists settings in a subtree.

methods.name: settings_read_callback
methods.description: Callback for reading a setting's value, supports hex and string types.

methods.name: settings_parse_type
methods.description: Parses string type to enum value for setting data type.

methods.name: cmd_read
methods.description: Handles 'settings read' command, reads and displays a setting.

methods.name: cmd_write
methods.description: Handles 'settings write' command, writes a value to a setting.

methods.name: cmd_delete
methods.description: Handles 'settings delete' command, deletes a setting.
